achievements.name: Future Gadget Lab
achievements.detail: Begin the tale in Rintaro Okabe's Future Gadget Laboratory in Akihabara.

achievements.name: Hououin Kyouma
achievements.detail: Follow a scene in which Okabe plays his self-styled mad scientist, Hououin Kyouma.

achievements.name: Phone Trigger
achievements.detail: Answer, reply to, or ignore a call or email when the Phone Trigger prompts Okabe.

achievements.name: Mail to the Past
achievements.detail: Send an email into the past with the gadget the Future Gadget Laboratory discovered.

achievements.name: Braun Tube Workshop
achievements.detail: Stop in at the Braun Tube Workshop on the floor beneath the laboratory.

achievements.name: MayQueen
achievements.detail: Meet Faris during a scene at the MayQueen maid cafe in Akihabara.

achievements.name: Another Lab Mate
achievements.detail: See a new companion enter the circle around the Future Gadget Laboratory.

achievements.name: Nakabachi's Conference
achievements.detail: Attend Doctor Nakabachi's time-machine press conference in Akihabara.

achievements.name: Yanabayashi Shrine
achievements.detail: Visit Luka at Yanabayashi Shrine while the laboratory's story passes through there.

achievements.name: One Ending
achievements.detail: Reach an ending that follows from the calls and emails Okabe chose to handle.

achievements.name: Another Ending
achievements.detail: Reach a different ending by handling the phone another way on a later read.

achievements.name: New Worldline
achievements.detail: Finish the new ending scenario this remake adds, on the worldline made for it.
